trans-unit.source: Dhaos hid his castle in a time rift...
trans-unit.target: Dhaos hid his castle in a time rift...

trans-unit.source: I expected the Sword of Time would expose it, but...
trans-unit.target: I expected the Sword of Time would expose it, but...

trans-unit.source: ...who could have imagined it'd send us straight to the entrance?
trans-unit.target: ...who could have imagined it'd send us straight to the entrance?

trans-unit.source: Pretty awesome, huh? The Rheairds woulda just been blown away.
trans-unit.target: Pretty awesome, huh? The Rheairds woulda just been blown away.

trans-unit.source: Yeah, so let's get back to kicking Dhaos' ass, you guys.
trans-unit.target: Yeah, so let's get back to kicking Dhaos' ass, you guys.
